modal.title: Create Lexware invoices
modal.description: Creates an invoice in Lexware for each selected order that has none yet, paid or not. Orders that already have one are left alone. Orders in other currencies than EUR are skipped. The results appear under Orders → Lexware documents.

extra_actions.label: Create Lexware invoice
extra_actions.hint: Creates the invoice for this order in Lexware now, or shows the one it has

modal.title: Create Lexware invoice
modal.description: Creates the invoice for this order in Lexware now, whether or not the order is paid. If the order already has one, nothing is created.
